source_title: Sentinel-2 MSI BOA Surface Reflectance & ISRO Bhuvan NRSC Agricultural Drought Monitoring
spatial_scope: 10m pixel composite for Nalgonda agricultural zone (Tile 44QME); not farmer field boundary polygon.
processing_method: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A Bottom-Of-Atmosphere (BOA) surface reflectance processed via Sen2Cor; cloud masking with scene classification layer (SCL < 4, > 7 excluded); NDVI calculated as (B08 - B04)/(B08 + B04) aggregated over agricultural cropland mask (ESA WorldCover 2021 class 40).
provenance_notes: Unverified demo fixture based on Sentinel-2 Level-2A regional tile composite; not a plot-level polygon extraction.
observation_vs_inference: Observation: Multispectral NIR/Red reflectance ratio (NDVI = 0.64). Inference: Typical vegetative vigor for irrigated Kharif rice. Remote sensing cannot distinguish fungal blight, bacterial leaf streak, or pest damage from abiotic stress.
warning: Canopy greenness index is aggregated over regional agricultural plots. Cloud contamination and standing water in paddy fields can skew indices. Not a field-level diagnostic.

source_title: Sentinel-2 MSI BOA Surface Reflectance & ISRO Bhuvan NRSC Agricultural Drought Monitoring
spatial_scope: 10m pixel composite for Khammam maize/paddy belt (Tile 44QNF); not farmer field boundary polygon.
processing_method: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A BOA reflectance (B08, B04) masked using ESA WorldCover cropland mask; mean regional NDVI computed over cloud-free agricultural pixels.
provenance_notes: Unverified demo fixture based on Sentinel-2 Level-2A regional tile composite; not a plot-level polygon extraction.
observation_vs_inference: Observation: Multispectral NIR/Red reflectance ratio (NDVI = 0.68). Inference: Robust crop vigor in riverine basin. High vigor does not exclude early-stage pest infestation beneath the crop canopy.
warning: Canopy reflectance aggregate. Dense canopy saturation limits sensitivity in peak growth stages.

source_title: Sentinel-2 MSI BOA Surface Reflectance & ISRO Bhuvan NRSC Agricultural Drought Monitoring
spatial_scope: 10m pixel composite for Krishna delta rice zone (Tile 44RPP); not farmer field boundary polygon.
processing_method: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A BOA reflectance (B08, B04) over Krishna delta paddy mask; Sen2Cor atmospheric correction.
provenance_notes: Unverified demo fixture based on Sentinel-2 Level-2A regional tile composite; not a plot-level polygon extraction.
observation_vs_inference: Observation: Multispectral NIR/Red reflectance ratio (NDVI = 0.71). Inference: Intensive deltaic paddy greenness. Reflectance index cannot replace field inspection for stem borer or leaf spot.
warning: Canopy reflectance aggregate. Waterlogged paddy conditions can lower spectral response in early tillering.
